Push-Up Progression Planner

Enter your current push-up max and get a full 6-week progressive plan with 3 sessions per week.

General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Stop if you feel pain and rest at least one day between sessions.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the most push-ups you can do in one set with good form.
  2. Press Generate plan.
  3. Follow the 3 weekly sessions (5 sets each, reps based on your max).
  4. Retest your max after week 6 and start a new cycle.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is it safe for beginners?

No — rest at least one day between sessions, and stop if you feel sharp pain. The plan builds volume gradually to stay safe.

What do I do after 6 weeks?

Test your true max again (fresh, after a rest day) and use the new number to generate your next 6-week cycle.

Can I adapt it for knee push-ups?

Yes — add 10% to your current max and keep the same structure, or repeat week 6 until you can do 3×15 comfortably.
